dog.description_text:
Balto is a whole lot of handsome wrapped up in one big, fluffy package!

Balto is a gorgeous brown-and-white Husky who has the sweetest blue eyes and a smile that will melt your heart. He's a big ball of love and floof who is always ready to make new friends, especially the four-legged kind! Balto absolutely loves playing with his doggy pals and is often the first one to encourage a shy friend to come out of their shell. Whether he's showing off his moves with his favorite toys, engaging in an enthusiastic game of tug or soaking up all the pets and affection he can get, Balto is happiest when he's having fun with his friends.

With his irresistible smile, playful personality and heart full of love, Balto is simply the best boy. Could he be your new best friend? Click the "Adopt Me" button to meet this fluffy sweetheart!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
